scope: Typing in the launcher now survives the gap between an accepted Elm publication and its preceding DOM frame. Popup-owned field callbacks preserve bounded text within the same lease and rebase only read-only query messages; external edits/buttons remain publication-strict, and replacement leases retire drafts. The original native pin/reorder/restart journey passes. Physical Enter and real AT-SPI press each launch the zero-window Editor pin once through GIO. Its observed running family then minimizes/restores without another launch, receives actual client keyboard input and paints 268,432 green pixels inside its native window region. Both private native campaigns exit normally.
missingObservations: Independent original-scenario review of taskbar-zero against the frozen interaction oracle and exact source/core/plugin/toolchain remains open.

This fixture covers one current zero-window catalog pin, physical Enter and focused AT-SPI press with actual Orca names/focus. Broader applications, cached/unfocused AT actions, audible speech/braille, pin/reorder popup paint and other original GUI scenarios remain separately unqualified.
Physical hardware/output/IME breadth, resource/journey budgets, reproducible package and reversible deployment/rollback remain release obligations.

observedFailures.native-typing-failed: Actual editor typing became tor after a pin refresh; old Html publication was rejected although current field lease survived. Fixed in Popup/Presentation and observed original native pin/reorder sequence now passes.
observedFailures.compiled-pin-fixture-failed: PinsReplay lacked the existing required native idle fact. Added NativePointerFixture.ready arrangement only; all original assertions unchanged.
observedFailures.native-observer-schema-failed: Fixture read label from native scene facts; title is read from the actual native snapshot instead.
observedFailures.native-premature-frame-failed: First current DOM/Coherent report preceded enabled native paint. Current exact host AT tree is observed within original wait before unchanged screenshot/pixel assertion; AT ack alone is never claimed as paint ack.
observedFailures.native-primary-assumption-failed: GIO launched/focused Editor. Frozen primary correctly minimized it; fixture had assumed it would stay inactive. Current fixture follows actual active state without post-launch focus manipulation.
observedFailures.native-log-interleaving-failed: Mesa worker stdout interrupted one large readonly JSON diagnostic at byte4182. Current fixture retains raw bytes/hash and waits for the next complete observation, filtering only observed Mesa-interleaved readonly diagnostics. Protocol receipts/requests, other malformed diagnostics and original deadlines remain strict.
